title: Gulf of Tonkin:  McNamara admits It didn't happen.
summary: A four-minute extract from the documentary The Fog of War in which Robert McNamara discusses the Gulf of Tonkin incident. He acknowledges that the second reported attack did not happen.
why: HN commenters cite it as primary-source evidence that the public was misled about the second Tonkin attack.

quote.text: The American public was told there were two distinct attacks on two separate nights, but that wasn't true
